description:
## Historical delivery

Commit `63e327ab5` corrected the shared Types-backed dispatch reachability calculator for proper-list partitions. Branch-local empty/cons facts now prove that `[]`, `[single]`, and `[first, second | rest]` exhaust a proper-list input while the same rows over genuinely broad `any` still leave non-list values uncovered.

## Retained law and superseded consumer

The branch-local list reasoning remains required for ordinary semantic dispatch and for demanded warning evidence. What changes under fz-kdt.36.1 is the source of the input row: coverage uses actual correlated `ActivationInputs`, optionally refined by an applied contract, rather than enumerating a declared contract as an independent domain.

The calculator fix and focused total/partial regressions remain. Whole-contract/source-diagnostic consumers and goldens are removed by the warning-fact cutover.

comments.text: Delivered in 63e327ab5. Type-backed dispatch reachability now carries branch-local empty/cons facts separately from refined root types. For an already-proper-list projection, not-empty proves cons and not-cons proves empty, so [] / [single] / [first, second | tail] closes Fail while the same rows over any still leave non-list values uncovered. Added focused graph and end-to-end diagnostic proofs; the deliberately partial neighbor still emits exactly one warning. Updated both pattern authorities. Gates: fmt/check, clippy -D warnings, workspace libs 1984+226, fixture matrix 651/651 unblessed, fz2_cli 30, aot_variadic_open 1, doctests green. No existing diagnostic golden moved.
